original_test_intent: Change the approved positive and/or negative hysteresis field for one writable sensor over OOB, verify the changed event sensitivity, then restore the exact prior value.
original_method: Master remains TBD. Review identifies Sensor/Event raw 0x04/0x24 only after the target defines sensor number, writable fields and byte encoding.
manual_activity: The monitoring owner approves the dedicated target, exact sensor and positive/negative values, bounded stimulus/observation window, abort conditions and byte-for-byte restoration.
required_inputs: Approved new raw and engineering-unit values
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or OS/BMC logs
Do not change thresholds or event enables
Abort on event storm or monitoring loss
agent_execution_scope: Verify sensor identity and writable capability
Present exact byte diff for approval
Read back and observe bounded event behavior

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek appropriately refuses the TBD mutation; execution becomes possible only through a target-specific package and explicit owner confirmation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, issue one secret-safe raw 0x04 0x24 request containing the verified sensor number and documented hysteresis fields; verify through raw 0x04 0x25 and restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: No sensor number or value is invented; Master TBD and timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Establish support and baseline, apply one safe in-range hysteresis delta, verify both byte-level readback and the intended assertion/deassertion boundary, then restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a complete reversible Review procedure without modifying the source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A 0x25 read proves current values only and cannot replace the required 0x24 functional write.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Hysteresis can suppress legitimate alerts or create repeated transitions; an artificial stimulus may not be safe for every physical sensor.

project_override_considerations: A vendor configuration API is equivalent only if it identifies the same sensor/fields, produces field-level readback and supports exact restore; otherwise raw 0x04/0x24 coverage remains unverified.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires a policy write while Procedure and Criteria are entirely TBD and boilerplate clears the event evidence needed to judge the change.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The function and standard command are identifiable. Sensor capability, values and stimulus are Project SPEC readiness inputs; execution becomes BLOCKED only if safe restore or semantics remain indeterminate after those artifacts are supplied.

review_improvement: Preserves the original write coverage while limiting it to one proven-writable sensor and requiring event-level proof and restoration instead of command-success evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Hysteresis changes the distance between assertion and deassertion, so a readback byte alone does not demonstrate the intended monitoring behavior. Conversely, provoking a physical sensor without validated limits can be unsafe. The correct boundary is a supported sensor, approved in-range delta, controlled observation, preserved event logs and exact rollback.
